content: Isak edde Rebekah Gerarot
Ibrahimor ṭaimot ṛat oilde he foilawa bade ar ugguwa raṭ oiye. Toi Isak Gerarot Filistini okkolor badša Abimelekor hãse giye.
Mabude Isakore deha diye edde hodde, "Tui entu Mišorot lami no zaisgoi, ãi tore ze zagar babute hoiyum tui he zagat bošoti gor.

Tui hotokkalolla ei zagat tak, edde ãi tor fũwati takiyore tore rahamot goriyum, kiyollahoile ãi tore edde tor bongšore ei zaga okkol diyum, edde tor baf Ibrahimor hãse ze hosom háiyi hiyan ãi furon goijjium.
Ãi tor bongšore asmanor tara zedun hedun goriyum edde ei zaga okkol hitarare diyum, ar tor bongšor duwara duniyair hár zatiye duwa faibo,
kiyollahoile Ibrahime ãr hota fuinne edde ãr hár dabi, ãr hokum okkol, ãr ain edde kanon okkol falon goijje."
Toi Isak Gerarot taigiyegoi.

Ar he zagar mainše hibar bouwore boute fusar goijje, hibaye hodde, "Hiba ãr boin." Hibaye "Hiba ãr bou" hoite ḍoraiye, kiyollahoile hibaye ḍoraiye ze "Rebekkalla boli hitara hibare mari felaibo, kiyollahoile hiba beši šundor."
Isake bout hal heṛe bošobaš gori bade, Filistini badša Abimaleke zanala bai dekedde, Isake hibar nizor bou Rebekah loi šuhag gorer.
Toi Abimaleke Isakore ḍaikke edde hodde, "Sa, hiba hameka tor bou! Tui kengori hiba 'Ãr boin' hoi faijjos?" Isake hitare zuwabe hodde, "Kiyollahoile ãi mone goijjilam ãi hiballa boli foran haraiyum."
Abimaleke hodde, "Tui ãrar loi endilla kiyolla goijjos? Ze hono mainše to tor bou loi gum zai farito, ar tui ãrare hosurbon banaifelaiti."
Toi Abimaleke hár manuš okkolore endilla hoi hokum zari goijje: "Ze honokiye ei manušwar berudde otóba hitar bouwor berudde za, hitare hameka marifela oibo."
Isake he dešot saš goijje edde he bosor hinot ek šot gun fošol faiye. Mabude hibare rahamot goijje.
Toi hiba ḍor owa šuru goijje, ar ekattu ekka bariuṛat takiyore beši ḍõr manuš boinne.
Ar hibattu goru sool edde beša beši gulam okkol oiye, ar Filistini okkole hibar loi riš goijje.
Henot hibar baf Ibrahim zinda taite hibar gulam okkole kujjilde hár kuwa okkolore Filistini okkole meṛi felaiyore búzaifeliye.
Bade Abimaleke Isakore hodde, "Tui ãrar hentu zagoi, kiyollahoile tui ãrattuwaro beši šoktiwala oiyos."
Toi Isak hentu giyegoi edde Geraror ḍeilot zai ṭambu gãijje edde heṛe taikke.
Toi hibar baf Ibrahim zinda taite kujjilde kuwa hinore Isake abar kuijje, zinore Ibrahim mori bade Filistini okkole búzaifelail, ar bafe hinore ze nam okkol dil hibaye hinore he ekkui nam okkol diye.
Isakor gulam okkole ḍeilot kuriyore heṛe ugguwa fanir nal faiye.
Kintu Geraror soolsoroya okkole Isakor soolsoroya okkol loi hoijja diye edde hodde, "Ei fani ãrar!" hetolla Isake he kuwar nam diye Ešek, kiyollahoile hitara hibar loi hoijja goijjil.
Bade hitara ar uggwa kuwa kuijje, kintu hiba loi o hitara hoijja goijje; hetolla hibaye hibar nam diye Sitnah.

Toi hiba hentu giyegoi edde ar uggwa kuwa kuijje, ar hiballa hitara hoijja no gore, ar hibaye hibar nam diye Rehobot edde hodde, "Šeš foijjonto Mabude ãrare farot zaga diye, ar ãra ei zagat fólwala oi faijjum."
Ar hentu hiba Beer-Šebat giye.
He raitta Mabude hibare deha diyore hodde, "Ãi tor baf Ibrahimor Allah, tũi no ḍorais; ãi tor fũwati asi, ãi tore rahamot goriyum; ar Ibrahimor hatire ãi tor bongšore baraidiyum."
Toi Isake heṛe ekkan kurbangah tiyar goijje edde Mabudor nam ḍaikke. Heṛe hibaye hibar ṭambu o maijje, edde hibar gulam okkole heṛe uggwa kuwa kuijje.
Bade Abimaleke hitar dusto Ahussat edde hitar foila šenafoti Fikolore loi Gerarottu Isakor hãse aišše.
Isake hitarare hodde, "Tũwara ãr hãse kiyolla aiššo, tũwara to hingša gori ãre hentu dũrai dila?"
Hitara hodde, "Ãra foriškar gori dekir ze Mabud tor fũwati ase; hetolla ãra baffilam ze 'tui edde ãrar maze uggwa wada sukti takon zoruri.' Aio, ãra tor loi hosom hái,
ãra zendilla šude tor balai bade hono hoti no gori edde tore šanti gori bidai dilam, hendilla tui o ãrar hono hoti no goribi. Ar ehon tore Mabude rahamot goijje."
Toi Isake hitaralla hánar entezam goijje, edde hitara há fiye goijje.
Tarfordin binna sore uṛi ekzon loi ekzone hosom háiye. Bade Isake hitarare bidai diye, ar hitara šanti gori hentu baisa diye.
He din Isakor gulam okkol aiyore hitarar kuijja uggwa kuwar babute Isakore hoiye. Hitara hodde, "Ãra fani faiyi!"
Hibaye hibare nam diye Šeba. Hetolla he šohoror nam aijo foijjonto Beer-Šeba.
Ar Išor boyoš sališ bosor oiyede šomot, Hetittiyo Beerir zi Yudit, edde Hetittiyo Elonor zi Bašmathore o, biya goijje.
Ar hitara Isak edde Rebekar zibonore tita gori tuillil.
